categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Huaye Aromas Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of lactone series synthetic flavors, focusing on gamma-position and delta-position lactone flavors. Their products are widely applied in food and beverage, daily chemicals, tobacco, and feed industries. The company also operates a subsidiary involved in aroma production and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis technologies including continuous reaction devices, catalytic filtration, hydrogenation, membrane separation, and reaction distillation for lactone synthesis. It emphasizes green production processes, organic waste gas treatment, and automation control systems. The firm holds numerous patents and proprietary technologies in lactone synthesis and production equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international flavor and fragrance giants such as Givaudan, IFF, dsm-firmenich, Symrise, MANE, and P&G. The products serve downstream industries like food and beverage, daily chemicals, tobacco, and animal feed. Over 60% of sales are exported to markets including Singapore, the US, the EU, Switzerland, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production facilities in Anhui Province, including Anqing and Hefei. It has a significant international presence with exports accounting for over 60% of revenue, serving customers across North America, Europe, and emerging markets in Asia and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Huaye Aromas operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the synthesis and manufacturing of aroma chemicals (lactone series flavors) which are then supplied to flavor and fragrance companies and downstream industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in green and sustainable production technologies, bio-fermentation of aroma compounds, and development of high-end and customized lactone flavors. It invests in expanding production capacity, optimizing processes, and enhancing product quality. Collaboration with academic institutions and continuous patent development underpin its innovation strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of synthetic aroma chemicals and flavors. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, with contracts based on product delivery and customer acceptance. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Globally, the company competes with major flavor and fragrance multinationals like Givaudan, IFF, dsm-firmenich, and Symrise. Domestically, it is a leading player in the lactone flavor segment with strong technical capabilities and brand recognition, steadily increasing its market share and challenging international incumbents in mid-to-high-end markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 345 million, a 28.12% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 22.09 million, a significant turnaround from prior losses. Total assets reached RMB 631.7 million with steady growth in equity. The company has demonstrated strong growth momentum and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high safety, stability, and irreplaceability of its lactone flavor products, supported by proprietary synthesis technologies and green manufacturing processes. Its products meet stringent international quality standards and certifications (e.g., Kosher, EU REACH). Strong R&D, customization capabilities, and collaboration with global leaders provide competitive differentiation and customer trust.
